title: [CON-1] `channelCID` is the exporter context for token, access key and sealing key, but is never d
description: Review finding CON-1: `channelCID` is the exporter context for token, access key and sealing key, but is never defined (lens CON). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:194, :202, :218; spec/03-spaces.md:55-97 (channel entries have `path`, `type`, `mode`, `name`, `mlsGroupID`, with no CID); spec/03-spaces.md:166, :173; spec/04-access-control.md:125. Fix: Define the per-channel identifier and its exact byte encoding as exporter context once in §3.3. Then point §5.2.2, §3.4 (`/broadcast-key/<channelCID>`), §6 and §7 at it. For DM groups, say which identifier and label apply. Today 04:125 uses `"agora-dm-token"` with empty context and gives no access or sealing derivation. Grep found no definition anywhere: `channelCID` appears only as a context and as a JSON field with the value `"bafyrei..."`. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Decision A implemented: channelCID gone from spec; channelID = 16 random bytes defined (spec/03-spaces.md §3.3); all exporters use MLS group_id for channels and DMs (spec/13-encoding.md §13.3); DMs named by group ID (spec/04-access-control.md §4.6)
